description: Intent i007 (net-epidx, snapshot s02) complete with a bounded negative result. I enumerated every .endpoint[...] access in drivers/net/usb/**, drivers/net/wireless/**, and drivers/net/wwan of snapshots/s02 (12 candidates triaged). No variant of the seed mechanism was found: every USB-descriptor endpoint[] index is either loop-bounded by the same altsetting's desc.bNumEndpoints (usbnet.c:98 usbnet_get_endpoints shared by ~30 NIC bind paths; cdc_ncm.c:683; lan78xx.c:2879; hso.c:3147; ipheth.c:462; ath9k/hif_usb.c guarded by bNumEndpoints<2 at 1228; rtlwifi/usb.c:333 bounded loop; orinoco_usb.c:1614 plus 14 analogous wireless drivers; rtl8xxxu_core.c:6392), explicitly guarded (r8152.c:6703 bNumEndpoints<3 before alt->endpoint+2 at 1819; cdc_ether.c:294 bNumEndpoints==1 before endpoint[0] at 297; cdc-phonet.c:341-349 bNumEndpoints==2 pattern before endpoint[0]/[1] at 366), or address-taken-then-NULL-rejected (qmi_wwan.c:674 &cur_altsetting->endpoint[0] with no bNumEndpoints check, but the USB core leaves the endpoint array NULL for zero-endpoint altsettings per drivers/usb/core/config.c:561-565 so &NULL[0] is NULL, qmi_wwan.c:676 rejects !dev->status before any dereference, and wdm_create validates the descriptor at cdc-wdm.c:811-813). Strongest remaining item is unresolved: hso.c:2773 dereferences mux->intr_endp->wMaxPacketSize where intr_endp comes from hso_get_ep() which returns NULL when no interrupt-IN endpoint exists; the NULL check at the assignment site was not read before the call budget expired, though even confirmed it is a missing-NULL-check on a type-scanned endpoint, adjacent to rather than identical with the seed's unvalidated assumed-index mechanism. Legacy drivers (kaweth, pegasus, catc, rtl8150, cx82310_eth) use hardcoded pipe endpoint numbers but never index the descriptor array, so they are outside the invariant. All evidence is recorded with exact file:line quotes in the final artifact at agent-state/findings/i007.json (findings: [], 12 classified candidates, 6 concrete limitations), checkpoint updated at agent-state/checkpoints/i007.json.
